test_read_jsonl: test reading line-delimited JSON strings into a pandas DataFrame using read_json with lines=True
test_to_jsonl: test writing a pandas DataFrame to JSON lines format using to_json with orient=records and lines=True
test_readjson_chunks: test reading line-delimited JSON files in chunks using read_json with chunksize parameter
test_readjson_nrows: test reading a limited number of rows from line-delimited JSON using read_json with nrows parameter
test_to_json_append: test appending multiple DataFrames to a JSON lines file using to_json with mode=append
